leastWorthwhile.text: Making the cut was predictable setup rather than an interesting decision, though it gave the plug a clear purpose.

surprise.text: The vessel was sealed but the skin above it remained open, so stopping bleeding did not mean the whole cut had healed.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the enzyme pairing was explicitly hinted at, and the other actions followed the cut and repair sequence.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the still-open skin heals after the bleeding stops.
